name: music-lessons
description: Lessons in playing an instrument or singing, online or in person.

languages.description: Languages it is offered in, as BCP 47 tags such as en or es.

howDealsGo: The student pays into escrow for a lesson or a set of lessons, and releases after each lesson is held. Done is the lesson given at the agreed time, for its full length. A timer to the teacher, set past the lesson, pays for a lesson given if the student goes quiet. Before paying, check whether you need your own instrument.
